summary: Monday weighs a US tech sell-off and a flare-up around Hormuz against record foreign buying and a firmer rupee, with monthly expiry packed into the only session before a holiday.

detail.leaders: Banks, which led last week's rally on record foreign inflows
detail.laggards: IT and AI-linked stocks after the US sell-off, plus smaller stocks that lagged last week
detail.tone: A look-ahead to Monday 23 November, the only session before Tuesday's holiday. Since the afternoon note the Gulf picture has darkened: two tankers struck near Hormuz, Iran hitting US bases in Bahrain, and US-Iran talks stalled. Domestic news stayed quiet.
